title: Quindim
description: Quindim is a dish from Brazil featuring chicken egg, desiccated coconut, coconut milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Separate seven egg yolks and whisk them with sugar without over-aerating; keep unused whites refrigerated for another recipe.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Butter the small molds and sprinkle the sugar evenly on their interiors so the quindim releases after baking.
Bake the coconut-yolk custards in a hot-water bath at 160°C until fully set; cool thoroughly before unmolding.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 90 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
